name: 72756 · Rogers, AR
findings: ZIP 72756 (Rogers) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72756 (Rogers) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72756 (Rogers) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
